data_fields.name: gap_ticks
data_fields.donor_constant: 200 ticks (gap after a window ends, before jitter)

data_fields.name: jitter_ticks
data_fields.donor_constant: 15 ticks (start offset is a random integer in [-15, 15])

data_fields.name: leeway_ticks
data_fields.donor_constant: 16 ticks (late data allowed after window end)

best_idea: Open a short, randomly placed, byte-capped server-side record window per player, and never let the record change a fight result.
decision_why: The donor's report channel is client-uploaded and unchecked, but Frankendom's server already receives every fight input, so only the window scheduling, the byte cap and the report-size guard transfer, as a sampled fight record for review (row 19).
acceptance: A server test over 10 simulated fights shows a record only for fights whose start tick falls in the sampled window, storage stops at the byte cap plus at most one 500-byte chunk, and kill and damage results are identical with the record on or off.
